definitions.A_V: pdrRad.out column 1, A_V,eff from the star; Cloudy AV(point) of save overview
definitions.cells: active cells of grid0.out; flagged (lgBlack, grid0.out column 3) cells are set aside from every statistic and counted in runcard.json cells
definitions.A_front: the smallest A_V among the cells with x(H+) < 0.3
definitions.bins: edges geomspace(AVmin, 0.999 A_front, 9) U geomspace(0.999 A_front, AVmax, 32); a bin is [a, b), the last [a, b]; per bin the geometric-mean A_V of its cells, n, and the 16th, 50th and 84th percentiles; bins with n < 3 are left out
definitions.n_H: n(H) + n(H+) + 2 n(H2), both codes; Cloudy n(H2) = H2 + H2* (.dens389)
definitions.Te: K; MOCASSIN grid1.out; Cloudy save overview Te
definitions.Tdust: K; MOCASSIN pdrRad.out (number-weighted over sizes); Cloudy save grain temperature weighted by the number of grains per bin of the same power law (d260_roellig)
definitions.x_*: n(X^i)/n(X): MOCASSIN grid2.out; Cloudy save overview (HII, HeII, HeIII, C2, C3, O2, O3)
definitions.H, H2, C, O, CO, OH, H2O, CH, HCO+, H3+: n(i)/n_H; atoms MOCASSIN grid2.out, molecules the chemistry (pdrGrid.out); Cloudy save species densities
definitions.sol_h2: s^-1 per H2; MOCASSIN h2Cells.out Sol(levels); Cloudy (PHOTON,H2=>H,H + PHOTON,H2*=>H,H) / n(H2 + H2*)
definitions.h2heat_*: h2Cells.out H2 heating per H of the level model (formation, dissociation, collisions within X) over MOCASSIN's heating, cells with heating > 0
definitions.pdrheat_*: h2Cells.out 3D-PDR's terms (formation, photodissociation, FUV pumping), the same way
definitions.h2dH_frac: Cloudy save heating, the H2 photodissociation heating's fraction (H2dH)
definitions.fronts: first crossing outward of medians: in A_V 59 log bins geomspace(max(AVmin, 1e-3), AVmax, 60), in r 60 shells linspace(0, 1.0001 rmax, 61); Cloudy on its zones
definitions.r_av: median A_V in 40 shells linspace(0, 1.001 rmax, 41), bins with n >= 3
definitions.lines: each code over its own Hbeta; Hbeta as a luminosity; ratio MOCASSIN / Cloudy; Cloudy from the last iteration's intrinsic block of its listing
definitions.h2lines: tools/h009_lines.py: Cloudy's strongest H2 lines of .linesint, matched to lineFluxH2.out by wavelength (air), each over its own Hbeta; ratio MOCASSIN / Cloudy
